Hi, I'm Om.

I design the things people see first: logos, social posts, posters and thumbnails. Then I make them move, editing reels and YouTube videos and animating titles in After Effects.

I care about clear type, colour that feels right and edits that never drag.

What I can make for you

  • Social media design

    Posts, carousels and stories that stop the scroll and still look like your brand.

    • Instagram and LinkedIn posts and carousels

  • Brand identity

    Logos and visual systems that make a brand easy to recognise.
